definitions.explanation: The act of writing down words spoken by another person, often as an educational exercise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{書取|かきと}り⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Today's class has a dictation test.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書取|かきと}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I will take dictation of the sentences the teacher reads.

examples.japanese: {書取|かきと}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{役立|やくだ}つ→役立つ：03168_yakudatsu⟧。
examples.english: Dictation is useful for practicing kanji.

notes:
{書取|かきと}り refers to dictation exercises where someone writes down what is spoken aloud.

FORMS:
⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write) + ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take) = {書取|かきと}り (taking down in writing)

EDUCATIONAL CONTEXT:
Commonly used in Japanese schools to test and practice kanji writing skills. The ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧ reads sentences aloud and students write them down, testing both listening comprehension and ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧ knowledge.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書取|かきと}り⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧: dictation test
- {書取|かきと}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: dictation practice
- {書取|かきと}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do dictation
- ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{書取|かきと}り: kanji dictation

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}り→読み取り：08714_yomitori⟧: reading comprehension
